messages:
amanda: FYI multiple customers started reporting hallucinations and bogus citations right after last night's model rollout. Acme and FinTrust both flagged it.

kyle: which model was promoted? the quant change landed around 22:05 right?

amanda: rollout id: rollout/2026-03-10-22:05 (canary -> gradual). Model id: rdx-open-203k-v2-quant. Canary passed basic smoke but at ~30% we started getting reports.

tara-cs: FinTrust example pasted into support ticket: 'Asked to summarize the new SEC rule; model invented clause numbers and misattributed sources' — customer is pretty upset and wants immediate rollback.

raj: quick look at logs: we see a sudden jump in top-k variance and some tokenization differences near the embedding layer after quant conversion. Attaching preliminary repro notes.

eli: can someone paste the exact prompt + response so I can try to repro locally?

tara-cs: prompt: "Summarize the new SEC rule regarding X. Provide citation." Response: "Section 14-b of the 1999 Securities Act..." (made-up, incorrect). Customer included full transcript in ticket.

kyle: repro on a dev box (100% reproducible against the quant variant, NOT reproducible on fp16):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rdx-open-203k-v2-quant","prompt":"Summarize the new SEC rule regarding X. Provide citation."}'
```
Response shows hallucinated section and bogus citations. Verified across two corpora.

raj: hypothesis: quantization conversion introduced a tokenizer mapping regression -> off-by-one in attention masks for a small token subset, causing context shifts and hallucination. Needs rollback to stop customer impact.

sre_oncall: can we rollback traffic for rollout/2026-03-10-22:05? what's the exact command/flow?

kyle: we can use deploy-bot to rollback. I'll initiate controlled rollback to rdx-open-203k-v2-fp16 for all traffic. This should take a couple minutes to propagate.

deploy-bot: @kyle initiated rollback of rollout/2026-03-10-22:05 -> target rdx-open-203k-v2-fp16. Progress: 0% -> 40% -> 100%.

deploy-bot: rollback completed. All traffic now routed to rdx-open-203k-v2-fp16.

amanda: confirmed with FinTrust and Acme — they see baseline behavior again. Good catch. We'll keep rollback in place while we create a hotfix.

mmiller: action items: 1) formal rollback postmortem, 2) add new regression tests for hallucination/citation checks to canary suite, 3) block auto-promote for quantization conversions until validated. I'll own the postmortem.

eli: for hotfix: need to re-run quantization conversion with corrected tokenizer mapping (PR #1234). Also add the specific FinTrust prompts to our nightly regression harness.

tara-cs: I'll notify impacted customers. @support-bot please send rollback notification and apology template.

support-bot: Draft queued for support review: "We rolled back a recent model update after reports of incorrect citations. We apologize; we've reverted to the prior model and are investigating. If you saw incorrect outputs, please share examples and transcripts."

kyle: temporary mitigation: pin all enterprise accounts to the fp16 variant until the quant profile has full verification. I'll add a routing rule and schedule a controlled opt-in for sensitive customers.

raj: filing incident ticket INC-20260310-1 with logs, model diffs, and failing prompt IDs attached. Root cause hypothesis and next steps included.

amanda: timeline: keep rollback; patch + tests by EOD tomorrow; opt-in test with FinTrust before any re-rollout.

eli: owners: raj -> repro + fix, kyle -> routing & rollback, mmiller -> postmortem, tara-cs -> customer comms. Drop any failing prompt IDs in the incident.

sre_oncall: monitoring dashboards enabled for hallucination/citation alerts for 1h. Will escalate if metric doesn't return to baseline.

amanda: :thumbsup: thanks team — keep updates in this thread and paste any failing transcripts into INC-20260310-1.
